name: TOB Bible Conversation Message
description: One turn in a TOB Bible Conversation — a regular (not child-table) doctype since a conversation can grow long and each message benefits from its own creation timestamp/ordering rather than a fixed-order child table row.

fields.label: References Cited
fields.description: Comma-separated plain reference strings this answer drew on, e.g. 'Romans 8:28, Romans 8:29' — source attribution, per the product's own requirement to show which passages influenced an answer.

fields.label: User Feedback
fields.description: Only meaningful on assistant messages — set by the user via a separate feedback endpoint, not at creation time.
